result.response:
### Plan
1. `models.py`: Validate `line_no` positive int, `error` str when set; `Summary` non-negative ints & `total == processed + dead_lettered`; `PipelineResult` post-init normalizing rows/dead_letters to tuples, dict/DeadLetter type checks, and summary count match.
2. `reader.py`: `iter_jsonl` skips empty/whitespace lines; parse with `parse_constant=None` so NaN/Infinity fail; catch json errors -> `RawRecord(line_no, line.rstrip('\r\n'), "invalid_json")`; check isinstance dict -> `not_object`. `iter_csv` line numbers start at 2.
3. `transformer.py`: Validate schema in constructor; reject non-dict/mapping data -> `(None, "not_mapping")`; check missing or None field -> `(None, f"missing_field:{name}")`; coerce bool checks, float finite check (`math.isfinite`), regex fullmatch for int; return `(None, f"bad_type:{name}")` on coercion failure; drop extra fields.
4. `pipeline.py`: Consume any iterable of `RawRecord`, handle `record.error` or transform error into `DeadLetter(record.line_no, error, record.data)`, preserve order, return `PipelineResult(tuple(rows), tuple(dead_letters), summary)`.


All requirements and edge cases have been implemented and verified:

- [models.py](file:///C:/Users/jayde/AppData/Local/Temp/ai_lab_disposable_workspaces/live_BENCH-016_28716_1795466822522_icm_v3/models.py): Enforced positive `line_no`, string `error`, non-negative summary metrics with `total == processed + dead_lettered`, tuple conversions, and exact count validations in `PipelineResult`.
- [reader.py](file:///C:/Users/jayde/AppData/Local/Temp/ai_lab_disposable_workspaces/live_BENCH-016_28716_1795466822522_icm_v3/reader.py): Handled skipping empty/whitespace lines, tracking 1-based line numbers, catching invalid JSON and non-standard bare literals (`NaN`, `Infinity`) with raw text preservation as `invalid_json`, checking `not_object`, and 2-based CSV row enumeration.
- [transformer.py](file:///C:/Users/jayde/AppData/Local/Temp/ai_lab_disposable_workspaces/live_BENCH-016_28716_1795466822522_icm_v3/transformer.py): Implemented schema validation, non-mapping check (`not_mapping`), missing/None field checks (`missing_field:<name>`), strict boolean exclusion, finite float validation, and dropped extra fields.
- [pipeline.py](file:///C:/Users/jayde/AppData/Local/Temp/ai_lab_disposable_workspaces/live_BENCH-016_28716_1795466822522_icm_v3/pipeline.py): Consumed any iterable of `RawRecord`, routed errors and failed transformations to `DeadLetter` maintaining order, and returned exact `Summary` counts in `PipelineResult`.
